title: A lifesaver for a small kitchen!
text: A lifesaver for a small kitchen!. My kitchen is very small and has very limited counter space, so I have a problem when I bake several sheets of cookies. Enter the Baker's Mate, which holds up to four cookie sheets. It is very sturdy and doesn't take up much counter space, allowing you to stack four cookie sheets at a time in a relatively small area (unlike trying to find room for four cooling racks!). It folds up for easy storage and is made in Sweden.

description: This kitchen cooling rack is perfect for breads, cookies and pastries. Rack allows air to circulate, which in turn, stops the cooking process. (Plus, you can serve those delicious baked goods all-the-sooner.) Rack has 4-tiers. Accommodates large or small batches of baked goods. Made of durable and long lasting metal.
